newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Moroccan firm turnover up to $40.2 mln/Q2.
newsitem.headline: Moroccan firm turnover up to $40.2 mln/Q2.

text.p: Morocco's car distributor and assembler Auto Hall said on Thursday its turnover rose to 350 million dirhams ($40.2 million) in the first half of the year, up 18.9 percent on the same period last year.
The company said it registered a turnover of 294.2 million dirhams in the first half of 1995.
Auto Hall posted a net profit of 46.3 million dirhams in the first half of the year but gave no comparative figures for the same period in 1995.
Auto Hall, was established in Casablanca in 1912, and has a capital of 230 million dirhams.
One of the 46 listed stocks on the bourse, Auto Hall, was last traded at 1,540 dirhams.
